newsitem.title: Albania: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Nov 11 - Durres - five vessels discharging of which 2 sugar, 1 chemicals, 1 bulk wheat, 1 rice/wheat flour, 5 vessels awaiting berth in roads for discharging of which 2 wheat flour, fishmeal, generals, sugar.

BULGARIA, Nov 11 - Varna - East - five vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering, 3 awaiting orders. West - four vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. Bourgas - East - 19 vessels due, 8 loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 14 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge, 9 under repairs/drydock. Tankers - 1 vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

Bourgas - 46 vessels operating of which 26 loading - 5 ammonia nitrate, 4 steel, 1 sling, 1 copper concentrates, 3 metal, 1 cigarettes, 2 clinker, 1 sunflowerseed, 1 pipes, 1 cars, 1 iron, 4 benzene, 1 other, 16 discharging - 2 sugar, 2 fishmeal, 3 containers, 1 ammonia sulphate, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 wheat, 1 cars, 1 copper concentrate, 3 petrol, 3 vessels discharging/loading - 1 containers/ammonia sulphate, 1 containers/metal, 1 general/ammonia nitrate, 1 cargo not nominated, 16 vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load - 2 tobacco, 1 metal, 1 clinker, 1 ammonia nitrate, 1 sunflower seed, 3 to discharge cars, copper and wheat, 3 awaiting orders, 2 cargo not nominated, 1 other.

Varna - 31 vessels operating of which 18 loading - 2 NTP, 4 soda, 1 granite, 1 kaolin, 2 urea, glass, 3 clinker, 1 cement, 2 sulphur acid, 1 SAS, 5 discharging - 3 coal, 2 phosphorite, 6 discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 10 waiting in roads of which 2 for loading (cement, magnesite), 1 for discharging phosphorite, 2 discharging/loading containers, 5 cargo not nominated.

ITALY, Nov 12 - Naples, Salerno - no vessels in roads. Gaeta - two bulkiers of which 1 to berth 14/11, the other 18/11. Genoa Commercial Port - three vessels in roads, no delays, 32 berthed, 6 in drydock. Multedo Oil Harbour - one vessel in roads, no delays, 3 berthed. Savona - no vessels in roads, no delays. Vado Lire - no vessels in roads, no delays. La Spezia - no vessels in roads, no delays, 6 vessels berthed, 6 under repair.

Leghorn, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Sarroch, Taranto, Ancona/Falconara - no vessels in roads, no delays. Civitavecchia - two vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta Oil Harbour - no vessels in roads, no delays, 4 berthed. Syracuse Oil Harbour - two vessels in roads. Ravenna - nine in roads, congestion due to fog. Venice - six vessels in roads. Trieste - one in roads.

LATVIA, Nov 12 - Riga - 15 vessels in port of which 14 operating - 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 1 cotton loader, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 tanker loaders, 1 scrap loader, 2 metal loaders, 1 frozen food discharger, 1 vessel awaiting operations, no delays, 18 vessels due. Ventspils - four in port of which 3 operating - 2 steel billets, 1 steel loader, 1 awaiting operations, no delays, 14 vessels due. Liepaja - six vessels operating, no delays, 1 due.

LITHUANIA, Nov 11 - Klaipeda - - vessels loading in port - 2 oil, 2 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 1 pellets, 3 metal, 2 cement, 2 timber products, discharging - 4 fish, 1 rapeseed, 1 rails, 1 bananas, 1 dolomite limestone, 1 vessel loading/discharging, 10 vessels in roads, 23 vessels due.

POLAND Nov 12 - Gdynia - 15 vessels operating, 1 grain vessel awaiting turn, 7 vessels loading at berth (2 coal, 2 bulk, 3 general cargo), 8 discharging at berth (4 general cargo, 3 grain, 1 tanker), 6 vessels under repairs/drydock, 25 vessels due. Gdansk - nine vessels operating, 4 awaiting turn (1 general cargo, 3 coal), 7 vessels loading at berth (2 coal, 1 general cargo, 4 bulk), 2 discharging at berth (1 grain, 1 tanker), 3 vessels under repairs, 14 due.

PORTUGAL, Nov 12 - Setubal - vessels in port - 3 loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 5 vessels under repairs/drydock. Vessels due - 14 for discharging, for loading, 2 vessels for repairs/drydock. Leixoes - vessels operating - 4 general cargo, 5 container vessels, 1 ro/ro awaiting berth totalling 29,152 dwt (handy size). Places vacant - 11 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes.

ROMANIA, Nov 12 - Constanta - 50 vessels operating of which 26 generals (20 loading, 6 discharging), 11 bulkers (4 loading, 7 discharging), 8 bagged chemicals loading, 3 tankers (1 loading, 2 discharging), 2 containers (1 loading, 1ischarging), 7 vessels waiting in roads of which 3 generals for loading, 2 bulkers for loading, 2 bagged cement for loading. Constanta South (Agigea) - four vessels loading general cargo, 1 bulker discharging. Mangalia - one bulker loading. Midia - four livestock carriers loading, 1 livestock carrier waiting.

RUSSIA, Nov 11 - Baltic Ports - St. Petersburg - 16 vessels operating of which loading - 4 non-ferrous, 1 paper, 1 container vessel, 2 fertiliser, 2 celluse, 1 coal, discharging - 4 frozen metal, 1 pipes, 3 vessels awaiting operations, 12 vessels due.

Nov 12 - Kaliningrad - 12 vessels in port of which 7 operating - 3 fertiliser loaders, 1 sugar discharger, 3 grain dischargers, 5 vessels awaiting operations, no delays, no vessels due. Vyborg - six operating, no delays, no vessels due.

Far East Ports - Vladivostok - 18 vessels in port of which 2 passenger, 7 loading (4 metal, 1 timber, 2 general cargo), 2 vessels discharging (1 general cargo, 1 grain), 7 waiting. Nakhodka - eight vessels in port of which 5 loading (2 metal, 2 timber, 1 general cargo), 3 waiting. Vostochniy - two vessels in port of which 1 loading coal, 1 waiting. Posyet - no vessels in port. Khasan - two vessels loading metal. No delays. No congestion in ports.

Black Sea - Novorossiysk - 12 vessels operating of which 7 loading - 1 pipes, 3 steel, 1 urea, 1 salt petre, 1 seeds, 5 discharging - 1 various, 2 rice, 1 cars, sugar, 11 vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load - 2 seeds, 2 steel, 1 molasses, 2 sheep, 4 to discharge - 1 rice, 1 barytes, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 luggage, 18 vessels due of which 13 to load - 1 scrap, 5 steel, 4 slabs, 1 vegetable, oil, 1 beetroot meal, 5 to discharge - 1 sugar, 1 castor oil, 1 general cargo, 2 luggage.

Oil Terminal - 12/11 - 2 vessels loading crude, 4 waiting in roads to load crude and fuel oil, 8 due to load crude and diesel oil. Northern Basin - Murmansk - five vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 2 steel, 1 NPK, 1 cabotage, no berthing delays, 18 vessels due during the week of which 9 loaders (6 apatite, 2 steel, 1 iron ore pellets), 9 dischargers (2 alumina, 4 cabotage, 2 general cargo, 1 anode paste).

SLOVENIA, Nov 11 - Koper - five vessels due during next 2 days of which 1 container for loading/discharging, 1 bulk carrier to load coal, 1 car carrier to discharge cars, 1 livestock vessel to load bulls, 1 general cargo to load steel profiles, 7 vessels berthed of which 2 loading coal/grain, 1 loading bulls, 1 container vessel loading/discharging, 1 ferry vessel loading/discharging, 1 car carrier discharging cars, 1 reefer discharging fruit, no delays expected.

SPAIN, Nov 11 - Aviles - five vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 coal, 1 zinc concentrates), 3 vessels loading (1 zinc, 2 steel). Gijon - four vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 iron ore, 1 cement), 2 loading (1 steel products, 1 cement). No delays or congestion in ports. Sagunto - 20 vessels in port operating of which 4 ro/ro discharging/loading, 1 loading steel products, 10 discharging steel product 1 loading general cargo, 1 loading perishable goods, 2 discharging timber/logs, 1 loading fertiliser, no vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

Nov 12 - Cadiz - 12 vessels operating of which 4 ro/ro, 1 sand, 1 wheat, 1 tobacco, 5 under repairs, no delays. Pasajes - 14 vessels in port of which 4 discharging scrap, 1 discharging general cargo, 1 discharging perlite, 1 discharging petcoke, 1 discharging china clay, 2 discharging magnesite, 3 loing steel, 1 discharging/loading cars, no delays.

UKRAINE, Nov 11 - Mariupol - ten vessels operating of which 9 loading - 5 fertiliser, 3 steel, 1 sunflowerseed, 1 discharging MAP, 6 vessels waiting in roads of which 3 for loading - 1 MAP, 1 slabs, 1 coal, 3 for discharging - 2 mustard seeds, 1 citrus, 35 vessels due of which 23 for loading - 1 urea, 1 mustard seed, 5 sunflowerseed, 10 steel, 1 grain, 2 coal, 3 fertiliser, 6 to discharge - 1 metal, 1 coal, 1 fluorspar, 1 bauxite, 2 equipment, 6 to discharge/load coainers.

Odessa - 13 vessels operating of which 5 loading - 1 urea, 1 metal, 1 sunflowerseed, 1 metal, 1 fuel oil, 2 discharging bananas and citrus, 1 discharging/loading containers, 4 under repairs, 1 waiting, 3 in roads of which 1 to load metal, 2 waiting, 12 vessels due of which 6 to load - 1 sunflowerseed, 1 paper, 1 seedcake, 3 metal, 3 to discharge - 1 sugar, 1 citrus, 1 grain, 2 to discharge/load containers, 1 passenger vessel.

Nov 12 - Ilyichevsk - steel cargo loading - 8 vessels alongside, 2 anchored, containers - 1 alongside, 1 anchored, general cargo - 4 vessels alongside. Odessa - steel cargo loading - 2 alongside, 4 due, containers - 2 alongside, 1 due, grain cargo loading - 1 vessel alongside, 2 anchored, 1 due, grain cargo discharging - 1 due, tanker loaders - 1 alongside, general cargo, 2 alongside, 2 due, fertilisers - 1 alongside. Mariupol - nine loading at berth (fertiliser, sunflowerseed, sulphur, metal products, 1 fertiliser discharging at berth, 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to load (fertiliser, metal products, mustard seed, coal.)

Kerch - five vessels under repairs, 2 due (cars, metal products). Berdiansk - four loading at berth (metal products, agri products), 2 awaiting orders to load agri products, 3 vessels due (metal products, coal, coke).

YUGOSLAVIA, Nov 12 - Bar - three vessels berthed of which 1 discharging iron ore, 1 discharging bananas, 1 loading metal and copper cathodes. Zelenika/Bijela - three vessels laid up, no commercial operations, 2 vessels under arrest.
